downstream_status.state: NOT PROPAGATED, deliberately. Every tracked artifact derived from this file still descends from the superseded 32470-row version. Propagation is scheduled with the next planned v5 rebuild, not with this data change.
downstream_status.evidence: Whole-row multiset comparison over the 23 fields the two files share, re-derivable from tracked Git objects alone: data/iedb_negatives_v5_merged.csv (36689 rows) contains every one of the superseded 32470 rows and exactly 0 of the 36 rows added here. data/immunogenicity_dataset_v5_provenance.json records iedb_negatives = 36689, so the shipped corpus data/immunogenicity_dataset_v5.csv descends from that merged file and therefore from the superseded negatives.
downstream_status.propagation_steps: scripts/merge_iedb_api_negatives.py --existing data/iedb_negatives_v5.csv --output data/iedb_negatives_v5_merged.csv, then scripts/build_dataset_v5.py, then the RF mode-31 retrain quoted in docs/model_cards/rf_31feature_integrated.md and docs/data_registry.md.
downstream_status.expected_effect_PREDICTION_NOT_MEASUREME: The 36 rows carry 35 distinct peptides, of which 29 are absent from data/immunogenicity_dataset_v5.csv and all 35 are absent from models/peptide_binding_matrix_v5.csv, so a rebuild does need fresh binding predictions. Their virus is Unknown (29) or Self (7), and both of those values are quarantined by a NAME-DETERMINISTIC path rather than by a depth threshold, which is why adding rows cannot lift the quarantine. Neither string is a key in scripts/build_dataset_v5.py's VIRUS_FAMILY_MAP (27 keys) nor in scripts/_dataset_utils.py's _VIRUS_NAME_MAP (21 keys, and nothing maps TO them), so virus_family stays null and apply_quarantine's null-family branch adds them to quarantined_viruses; the mask it then applies is df['virus'].isin(quarantined_viruses), which catches every row with those virus values regardless of source_type. The threshold path is ruled OUT by measurement against the shipped corpus, where both pass the depth thresholds by wide margins: Unknown 4577 rows and 4576 real negatives, Self 3811 and 3811, against MIN_ROWS_PER_VIRUS 50 and MIN_REAL_NEGATIVES_PER_VIRUS 10. These rows are therefore expected to land quarantined and leave the active training matrix, and hence the RF mode-31 figures, unchanged. This contradicts the superseded sidecar's assertion that regeneration 'moves published figures'. It is now a mechanism read out of the build code plus a measurement of the CURRENT corpus, which is stronger than the bare correlation this field first recorded, but it is still NOT a measurement of a rebuild that has not been run. Confirm it against the rebuild before citing it.
downstream_status.guard: tests/test_iedb_negatives_v5_composition_guard.py::test_downstream_merge_lag_is_pinned_not_silent pins the 36-row lag and fails loudly if it changes size in either direction, so propagation cannot happen silently and neither can a second unrecorded edit.
